subject: Building Technology
chapters: Chapter 1: Introduction to Buildings & Site Investigation, Soil Suitability
Chapter 4: Doors, Windows, Stairs & Building Openings
Chapter 6: Damp-Proofing, Termite Proofing, Thermal/Acoustic Insulation & Plastering/Painting

questions.text: Classify Buildings based on occupancy according to National Building Code (NBC 206) and National Building Code of Nepal (NBC). Explain basic building components: Substructure (Foundation, Plinth) vs. Superstructure (Columns, Beams, Walls, Slabs, Roofs).

Explain shallow foundation types for residential buildings: Strip Footing, Pad Footing, Combined Footing (Rectangular and Trapezoidal), Strap (Cantilever) Footing, and Raft (Mat) Foundation with neat plan and sectional sketches.

Compare English Bond vs. Flemish Bond (Single Flemish and Double Flemish) in brick masonry with elevation and isometric view sketches for 1-brick ($230\,\text{mm}$) and 1.5-brick thick walls. What are Queen Closers, King Closers, and Bat?
Explain Stone Masonry classification: (a) Rubble Masonry (Random rubble, Coursed rubble), and (b) Ashlar Masonry (Fine ashlar, Ashlar chamfered). Compare brick masonry vs stone masonry.

questions.chapter: Chapter 6: Damp-Proofing, Termite Proofing, Thermal/Acoustic Insulation & Plastering/Painting
questions.text: Explain Cavity Walls (Outer leaf, Inner leaf, Cavity width $50-75\,\text{mm}$, Wall ties, Weep holes). What are the thermal insulation, damp-proofing, and sound-insulation advantages of cavity walls?

Explain types of Ground Floors (Cement concrete floor, Terrazzo/Mosaic floor, Marble floor, Timber floor). Describe the step-by-step construction of a ground floor with hardcore, sand bed, DPC layer, plain cement concrete, and floor finish.

Classify Pitched Roofs: Lean-to roof, Couple roof, Couple close roof, Collar beam roof, King Post Truss, and Queen Post Truss. Draw a neat labeled sketch of a King Post Roof Truss and label: Principal rafter, Tie beam, King post, Struts, Purlins, Cleats, Common rafters, and Ridge piece.

questions.chapter: Chapter 4: Doors, Windows, Stairs & Building Openings
questions.text: Explain Staircase Design principles: Going ($G$), Rise ($R$), Tread, Landing, Pitch/Slope ($25^\circ-40^\circ$), Headroom ($\ge 2.1\,\text{m}$), and thumb rules ($2R + G = 600-630\,\text{mm}$). Design an open-newel / doglegged RCC staircase for a residential building with vertical floor height of $3.3\,\text{m}$ and stair hall size $2.5\,\text{m} \times 5.0\,\text{m}$.

questions.chapter: Chapter 4: Doors, Windows, Stairs & Building Openings
questions.text: Explain types of Doors: Paneled door, Flush door (Solid core vs Hollow core), Glazed door, Louvered door, Collapsible steel door, and Rolling shutter. Draw elevation and sectional view of a fully paneled wooden door.
Explain Dampness in buildings: Causes (Capillary rise from ground, Rain penetration through walls, Condensation, Defective plumbing) and Damp Proofing Course (DPC) materials and installation methods.

Explain Plastering in building construction. Describe the 3-coat plastering process: Rendering coat (Scratch coat), Floating coat, and Finishing coat. Explain common defects in plastering: Blistering, Cracking, Efflorescence, Flaking, and Peeling.

Explain Pointing in brick/stone masonry (Flush pointing, Recessed pointing, V-grooved pointing, Tuck pointing, Weathered pointing). Explain ingredients of paint (Base, Vehicle/Binder, Solvent/Thinner, Drier, Pigment) and painting on new plastered walls.

Explain Causes of Foundation Failure (Unequal settlement, Lateral movement of soil, Shrinkage of subsoil, Tree roots, Earthquakes) and explain Underpinning techniques (Pit method and Pile method) to strengthen existing foundations.

questions.chapter: Chapter 4: Doors, Windows, Stairs & Building Openings
questions.text: Explain types of Windows: Casement window, Sash window, Bay window, Clerestory window, Skylight, and Dormer window. Explain natural ventilation principles: Stack effect (buoyancy) and Wind-driven cross-ventilation.

questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Introduction to Buildings & Site Investigation, Soil Suitability
questions.text: Explain Scaffolding, Shoring (Raking shore, Flying shore, Dead shore), and Formwork (Shuttering) for RCC beams and columns. When can formwork be stripped safely?
